final:
I changed the attachment list and detail endpoints so that read requests only return attachments for model types the user has view permission on. Before, any logged-in user could list or fetch every attachment, whatever their roles. The 52 tests you listed pass.

The change is a `get_queryset` method on `AttachmentMixin` in `src/backend/InvenTree/common/api.py`. For GET, HEAD and OPTIONS it excludes attachments whose model type the user can't view, using each model's `check_related_permission('view', user)`. Superusers are not filtered. Write requests are not filtered, because they already return 403 through their own permission checks. I didn't add a test for the new read filtering, so it is only covered indirectly by the existing tests passing.

An attachment the user can't view now returns 404 on GET rather than 403.

CHOICE: Filter attachment list/detail reads by the user's view permission on each attachment's model type, because any authenticated user could previously read all attachments regardless of roles.
